description: Promise-based file APIs (`readFile`, `writeFile`, `mkdir`, `rename`, `rm`). The default for application code.
`readFileSync` and friends block the event loop. Fine at startup and in CLIs, never inside request handlers.
Error code for "no such file or directory". Branch on `error.code`, never on the message.
Write a temporary file in the same folder, then `rename` it over the target so readers never see a partial file.
The folder the process started in. Relative paths resolve against it, not against the source file.
`existsSync` followed by a read or write can fail because the file changed in between. Try the operation and handle the error code.
